title: 17 — Valdez Estate: Parents and Spouse Without Descendants

story.narrative: Arsenio Valdez died testate without children or other descendants. His legitimate parents, Mateo and Lourdes, and his wife Elena survived him. A sister and nephews are family members but are not compulsory heirs while both parents live. Arsenio's will confirms the protected shares, legacies a dialysis clinic under a mixed suspensive condition, and gives a research legacy subject to a resolutory diversion condition. The original clinic legatee predeceased him, activating a simple substitute.
story.circumstances: The marriage, filiation, ownership, capacity, probate, and valuations are stipulated. There are no descendants, donations subject to collation, or other debts. Under Articles 889, 890, and 893, the parents collectively receive one-half, the surviving spouse one-fourth, and the remaining one-fourth is disposable. The will expressly directs the clinic recipient to discharge its identified debt from that interest. The net equity alone is charged against the free portion.
keyFacts: Net hereditary estate: PHP 24,000,000.
Mateo and Lourdes are the nearest legitimate ascendants and divide their collective legitime equally.
Elena's one-fourth legitime is taken from the half otherwise disposable.
The sibling and nephews receive no legitime; a voluntary gift may reach them only from the remaining free quarter.
Rosa predeceased Arsenio, so Nico takes the clinic only as the named substitute, not by representation.

persons.role: Surviving spouse and concurring compulsory heir

persons.role: Sister; collateral relative without a legitime

conditions.text: Rosa receives the clinic if the health department renews its accreditation and she establishes a subsidized dialysis program within eighteen months; Rosa predeceased Arsenio, so Nico is called. The will expressly carries the nonpersonal program requirement to Nico. Accreditation was renewed and Nico established the program within eighteen months; he accepted. Celia has no gift or substitution under this will.
conditions.substitutionNote: The named substitute replaces the predeceased legatee for the same disposable gift.

conditions.text: The Foundation receives the bond portfolio immediately. Its gift terminates if it diverts the principal to administrative salaries during the first five years. No diversion has occurred.
conditions.substitutionNote: This is a condition attached only to a voluntary legacy.

One-half of the parents' collective legitime.

title: 18 — Ramos Estate: Grandparent Lines, Spouse and Illegitimate Children

story.narrative: Celestino Ramos died with no legitimate descendants and with both parents already dead. At the nearest ascending degree, both paternal grandparents and only the maternal grandmother survived. His wife Maribel and two duly acknowledged illegitimate children, Paolo and Regina, also survived. The will layers a brief substitution over a cash legacy and a one-degree fideicommissary transfer over an art archive. This forces line-based division among grandparents before the concurring shares and free eighth are allocated.
story.circumstances: The grandparents are of equal degree. Filiation, recognition, marriage, ownership, capacity, and will formalities are stipulated. Under Articles 890 and 899, ascendants receive one-half, illegitimate children one-fourth, the spouse one-eighth, and only one-eighth remains free.
keyFacts: Net estate: PHP 40,000,000.
The paternal and maternal lines split the ascendant legitime equally; persons within each line divide per capita.
Two paternal grandparents share their line, while the sole maternal grandmother takes the maternal line.
Paolo and Regina divide the illegitimate children's collective quarter equally.
The voluntary gifts are confined to the PHP 5,000,000 free eighth.

conditions.substitutionNote: Reciprocity applies only inside the divisible disposable legacy.

Wilma must preserve the art archive and transmit it intact to her living child Xavier upon Wilma's death. Both are alive and capable at Celestino’s death. Wilma remains alive at accounting; the express duty applies solely to this free-portion movable archive legacy. Ursula and Victor reciprocally substitute for each other in the deposit legacy upon predecease, repudiation or incapacity. If only one remains, that survivor takes the entire vacant share, not 2/3 or 1/3 of it. Both accepted in the baseline, so this fallback does not activate.

doctrines: Representation never operates in the ascending line; nearest ascendants take in their own right.
Equal-degree paternal and maternal ascendants divide first by line, then per capita within each line.
In three-class concurrence, Article 899 leaves a free eighth.
recordLimitations: All status and recognition facts are stipulated.
Current fiduciary value is counted once.

explanation: A line-by-line grandparent problem combining secondary heirs, a spouse, illegitimate children, brief substitution, and a fideicommissary devise.

title: 19 — Soriano Estate: Two Legitimate and Five Illegitimate Children

story.narrative: Damian Soriano was survived by his wife Sofia, legitimate children Andres and Beatriz, and five duly proved illegitimate children: Carlo, Dina, Emilio, Flora, and Gregorio. His will purported to leave a PHP 8,000,000 resort interest and a PHP 2,000,000 cash legacy to a friend under a simple substitution, while separately confirming each compulsory heir. The nominal half-share formula for each illegitimate child collides with the cap on the free portion after the spouse is first satisfied, so the five illegitimate children share the remaining PHP 12,000,000 and the outside legacy is reduced completely.
story.circumstances: All seven filiations, the marriage, ownership, and probate facts are stipulated. The exercise applies Articles 888, 895, and 897: legitimate children first receive their collective half; the spouse receives one legitimate-child share; illegitimate children receive the balance available for their legitimes, subject to the statutory cap.
keyFacts: Net estate: PHP 48,000,000.
Andres and Beatriz divide the legitimate children's collective half: PHP 12,000,000 each.
Sofia receives PHP 12,000,000, equal to one legitimate child's legitime.
The five illegitimate children's nominal PHP 6,000,000 each cannot fit; their collective legitime is capped at the PHP 12,000,000 remainder.
No disposable portion remains, so every outside legacy or legacy is fully reduced.

The resort business-interest legacy would terminate if its holder converted protected mangrove land into private villas within ten years. doctrines: The spouse's legitime is fully satisfied before applying the aggregate ceiling on illegitimate children's legitimes.
An inofficious devise is reduced before any substitute can enlarge the disposable pool.
Concurring heirs do not form one undifferentiated per-capita class.

title: 20 — Bautista Estate: Nearest Parent and Three Concurring Children

story.narrative: Eloisa Bautista died without legitimate descendants. Her father predeceased her, her legitimate mother Remedios survived, and both paternal grandparents were still alive. Eloisa also left her husband Gregorio and three acknowledged illegitimate children. The nearer surviving mother excludes the grandparents from the secondary-heir legitime, while the spouse and illegitimate children concur. A predeceased nephew's charitable legacy activates a simple substitute, and a second legacy uses reciprocal fallback language.
story.circumstances: The family status, recognition, marriage, ownership, and probate facts are stipulated. Under Articles 890 and 899, Remedios takes the full ascendant half, the three illegitimate children share one-fourth, Gregorio takes one-eighth, and one-eighth remains disposable.
keyFacts: Net estate: PHP 36,000,000.
The surviving legitimate mother takes the entire PHP 18,000,000 ascendant legitime because the father is dead.
Paternal grandparents are excluded by the nearer surviving mother; there is no representation in the ascending line.
Gregorio receives PHP 4,500,000 and the three illegitimate children receive PHP 3,000,000 each.
The PHP 4,500,000 free eighth funds the substituted scholarship legacy and a reciprocal legacy.

computationGuide.title: Apply proximity among ascendants

The will expressly charges the identified property debt to the recipient, so only net equity is credited. Ines and Jaime receive the scholarship deposit in equal shares; if either cannot take, the survivor receives the vacant half. The tutorial-center gift terminates if the holder closes the free program during the first three years without a government closure order. Ines has kept the program open at accounting; no return is due.

doctrines: The nearer surviving parent excludes more remote ascendants.
There is no representation in the ascending line.
The spouse and illegitimate children concur with the legitimate parent under Article 899.
